mock-settings-get.description: Answers the runtime settings: the delivery delay, the automatic delivery, the webhook URL and secret and the default sender.

responses.description: The current settings come back as JSON.

mock-settings-put.description: Applies a partial change: only the sent fields change and the others stay as they were. A value of the wrong type refuses the whole change.

fields.name: deliveryDelayMs
fields.description: The time between queued and delivered, in milliseconds: from 0 to 2147483647.

fields.name: autoDeliver
fields.description: When false, the message stays in queued until someone changes the status by hand.

fields.name: webhookUrl
fields.description: The URL that receives the status and inbound events; empty, no webhook goes out.

fields.name: webhookSecret
fields.description: The secret that signs the webhook body with HMAC-SHA256; empty, the webhook goes out unsigned.

fields.name: defaultFrom
fields.description: The sender used when the request names none.

responses.description: The settings with the change applied come back as JSON.
The delay is not an integer: the invalid_settings error refuses the change.

error.message: deliveryDelayMs must be an integer number of milliseconds from 0 to 2147483647.

mock-inbound.description: Stores the message the handset received, with the inbound direction and the received status, and fires the inbound webhook. Without a to, the default sender is used.

fields.name: from
fields.description: The number that wrote the message, in the E.164 format.

fields.name: to
fields.description: The number that received the message; without it, the default sender is used.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The text of the message, up to 1600 characters.

responses.description: The inbound message was stored and comes back as created.
The origin number is not E.164: the invalid_from error refuses the message.

mock-status.description: Moves an outbound message to the status asked for and tells the webhook. errorCode is optional and goes into the error of the failure.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the message that changes status.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The new status: sent, delivered, undelivered or failed.

fields.name: errorCode
fields.description: The code of the failure; without it, each status carries its own.

responses.description: The message with the new status comes back as JSON.
The status is not one of the four allowed: the invalid_status error refuses the change.

error.message: The status must be one of sent, delivered, undelivered, failed.

responses.description: The id does not exist: the not_found error answers that the message is unknown.

mock-reset.description: Drops every message and every webhook attempt; the mock goes back to how it looked when it started.

responses.description: The mock was cleared; the answer has no body.

mock-deliveries.description: Answers the last attempts to post a webhook, with the URL, the result and the body that was sent.

responses.description: The list of attempts comes back as JSON, newest first.

mock-deliveries-clear.description: Drops the recorded attempts; the messages stay in the mock.

responses.description: The log was emptied; the answer has no body.

mock-demo.description: Seeds a sample inbox: a bank code and the reply, a delivery notice, a long promotion and a number that always fails. The outbound messages go through the real lifecycle.

responses.description: The sample messages were created and come back as JSON.

health.description: The one route any page may call: it answers the state of the service and the version, asking for no key and no local host.

responses.description: The service answers status, service and version as JSON.

mock-ws.description: The connection starts with a snapshot frame (messages, settings, deliveries and version) and then receives the events of the mock: message.created, message.updated, message.deleted, reset, settings.updated, delivery and deliveries.cleared. /ws and GET /sms/send refuse a foreign Origin.

responses.description: The connection upgrades to a WebSocket and the frames start to arrive.
